Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving your reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recorded performance—it seems the commitment needs to demonstrate the improvement you want us to trust. We want measurable defect reduction with proportionate financial accountability, not penalties that undermine corrective action. How would you support a binding quality commitment with a corrective-action report that demonstrates how you will achieve and sustain it?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 800 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You acknowledge the quality record while stressing that you cannot surrender margin; it sounds like financial exposure, rather than the evidence, is the sticking point. We want a lasting partnership built on measurable defect reduction and clear accountability for complaint costs. How can the corrective actions in your attached report support a binding quality commitment and make that accountability workable?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 43.27 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Kind regards
Marek Lis
